critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/App.js had DUPLICATE imports (CmsPages, CashSessions, Encaissements, ProfitLoss, BrandsCategories, AcceptanceChecklist declared twice, lines 36-41 AND 42-47), causing a hard Babel parse error 'Identifier CmsPages has already been declared' — frontend was failing to compile when I arrived. Fixed by removing the second import block. Main agent should audit for similar duplicate import regressions after bulk refactors.

GET /api/integrations only masks whatsapp_meta_token but leaves meta_pixel_id, tiktok_pixel_id, whatsapp_phone_id, wifi_printer_ip raw. Pixel IDs are generally non-secret, but phone_id/printer_ip could be considered sensitive. Minor hardening suggestion: mask all vendor IDs for non-admin viewers (currently any authenticated user can GET).
GET /api/integrations is readable by any authenticated user (Depends(get_user)). A sales agent should not need to see WA token prefix/suffix. Suggest require_role('admin','manager') on GET as well.

/api/cash-sessions/open rejects a new session with 400 globally when ANY session is still open — this does not scope by store or by user. If two stores (store-cocody, future store-2) run POS simultaneously, store 2 cannot open a drawer. Add store_id to the uniqueness filter.

/api/profit-loss recomputes COGS by iterating all orders then doing N product look-ups serially (await db.products.find_one in a loop). On 5000 orders this is 5000 RTTs. Suggest a single $lookup pipeline or bulk fetch of distinct product_ids first.

DEFAULT_PAGES is auto-seeded only on first GET /api/pages — if an admin DELETEs 'about', then GET returns only remaining 3 and will NOT re-seed because the collection is non-empty. Documented behaviour, but worth a UI warning before deleting default pages.
/api/encaissements and /api/profit-loss ignore store filter — any store manager sees aggregated company data. Consider scoping by user's assigned store for role=manager.
CmsPages.jsx React Hook useEffect warning (missing dep 'load') — cosmetic ESLint warning, not blocking.

/api/integrations PATCH response is {ok:true} but does not echo back the mutated/masked integrations snapshot — frontend must GET again to refresh. Minor UX: return the same payload shape as GET for optimistic UI.
